mission: Gate-1E Immediate Application / Replay Primitive Discovery

stage_b_private_setter.source_semantics: non-NULL copies exact 0x3C to plane B cache; NULL reuses existing cache
stage_b_private_setter.enable_guard: live registers are written only when plane+0x1E8 != 0
stage_b_private_setter.barrier: dmb sy after live B register programming and before unlock

avenues.name: existing public Sony display / public IFTU API
avenues.evidence: ksceDisplaySetColorSpaceMode only changes SceDisplay mode state and does not immediately replay B. ksceIftuCsc directly programs B, A, csc_control and a broad IFTU configuration transaction rather than entering the B hook chain.
avenues.reason: No narrow public B-only immediate replay API was found; public IFTU CSC has materially broader side effects and bypasses Stage-B hook ownership.

avenues.name: internal SceDisplay replay/state producer
avenues.evidence: 0x81000A2C constructs fresh 0x3C B and A objects and calls both private setters. 0x81000C2C invokes it while also controlling DSI/pervasive setup and IFTU enable. Direct B-producing routines 0x81002C94 and 0x81002FF4 also construct/program A and mutate SceDisplay globals.
avenues.reason: Fresh Sony baseline generation is attractive, but the smallest identified producers are not B-only and their internal context/state ABI is broader than necessary. Retained as natural replay evidence, not selected for immediate control.

avenues.name: patched Stage-B export / taiHEN chain-head reentry
avenues.evidence: Pinned taiHEN patches the original function entry to the chain head; later hooks are linked behind it; TAI_CONTINUE walks successor then saved original. Calling the resolved export from outside hook_b therefore enters the current full chain, whereas calling it from inside hook_b would recurse.

avenues.name: original/private Stage-B Lowio setter
avenues.evidence: ABI and complete transaction are statically closed. Setter owns a per-plane low spinlock, updates exact 0x3C cache, conditionally writes all live B registers, executes dmb sy and returns 0 on valid planes.
avenues.third_party_hooks: direct original/trampoline call would bypass some or all hooks
avenues.selection_note: Strong fallback, but dominated by L2 if chain-head physical discriminator passes.

avenues.name: related private Lowio replay/programming helpers
avenues.evidence: The two helpers inside the B setter are spinlock acquire/release. ksceIftuEnable replays cached CSC but also broader IFTU state.
avenues.reason: No smaller dedicated B commit helper was found below the setter; the setter is already the coherent minimal Sony transaction.

avenues.name: Sony cache mutation plus legitimate commit
avenues.evidence: The private B setter already performs cache mutation and live commit atomically under Sony's lock. No distinct narrower cache-consumer helper was identified.
avenues.reason: Separating cache mutation from commit would duplicate a weaker form of the already-proven private setter.

avenues.name: exact Stage-B MMIO programming
avenues.evidence: All 15 B register offsets, widths and write order are reconstructed exactly; the retail setter follows them with dmb sy.
avenues.cache_coherence: MMIO-only would leave Sony B cache stale; production use would require explicit cache synchronization or equivalent
avenues.selection_note: Authorized fallback but currently dominated by L2/L3 because those preserve Sony cache and synchronization automatically.

avenues.name: broader IFTU control/latch programming
avenues.evidence: The private B setter writes live B while enabled with no csc_control toggle or enable edge, and Gate-1C proved setter-mediated B mutation visibly affects the LCD.
avenues.reason: No additional latch/control transition is evidenced as necessary for the Sony setter path. Reopen only if a future exact-MMIO experiment proves B register writes alone do not latch.

current_selection.candidate: L2 patched Stage-B export / taiHEN chain-head reentry
current_selection.why: It combines the synchronized/cache-coherent Sony private setter transaction with full current taiHEN hook-chain participation and requires no guessed ABI or direct MMIO.
